stages.name: Phishing and AitM Token Theft
observables: fake login pages capturing usernames and passwords

stages.name: Brute Force and Password Spraying
observables: testing common passwords (e.g., Password01) across multiple accounts
credential stuffing using data from previous breach dumps

stages.name: Infostealer Credential Harvesting
observables: theft of browser cookies and session tokens
harvesting of autofill data from endpoints
infostealer execution disguised as fake downloads or ads

stages.name: Local Credential Dumping
observables: Use of Mimikatz to extract password hashes
copying SAM, SECURITY, and SYSTEM Registry hives to capture hashes

stages.name: Abuse of Valid Accounts for Lateral Movement
observables: impossible travel (logins from two distant locations in a short timeframe)
use of legitimate employee credentials to reach internal applications

stages.name: Impact and Ransomware Encryption
observables: business email compromise involving fraudulent wire transfers

scenario.summary: Threat actors use phishing, adversary-in-the-middle (AitM) attacks, and infostealers to obtain valid credentials and session tokens. These stolen identities fuel lateral movement, privilege escalation, and credential dumping to achieve high-impact outcomes like business email compromise and ransomware.

meta.rationale: The hunt prioritizes hosts identified as internet-exposed and vulnerable. If the scoping step returns no results, the subsequent activity queries run estate-wide to find opportunistic attacks on unprofiled assets.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has exploited an internet-facing vulnerability (T1190) and is now using local credential dumping or infostealers to harvest credentials before initiating a high-volume ransomware encryption event.

hunt.name: Endpoint Credential Harvesting and Host Impact
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the host-level progression of a credential-theft campaign. It begins by correlating vulnerabilities with internet exposure, then branches to investigate three distinct endpoint behaviors: rare binaries executing from user-writable paths (infostealers), the use of comsvcs.dll for LSASS memory dumping, and volumetric file modification activity characteristic of ransomware encryption. By joining these disparate signals, the hunt identifies high-confidence host compromises that individual detection rules may miss.

config.content: SELECT v.device_uid, d.hostname AS device_hostname, v.cve_uid, v.affected_package_name, e.domain_or_ip AS exposed_as FROM hb_vulnerability_finding v JOIN hb_devices d ON v.device_uid = d.device_uid AND v.provider = d.provider JOIN hb_exposed_assets e ON (d.ip_address = e.ip_address OR d.hostname = e.domain_or_ip) WHERE v.severity_id >= 4 AND v.status != 'suppressed' AND v.collected_at >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Correlate critical vulnerabilities with known internet-facing assets to identify the highest-risk targets for initial exploitation.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts that are both internet-exposed and carry critical vulnerabilities. Silence indicates no currently known overlap between exposed assets and unpatched findings.

primitive_config.label: Identify Vulnerable and Exposed Hosts
primitive_config.content: SELECT v.device_uid, d.hostname AS device_hostname, v.cve_uid, v.affected_package_name, e.domain_or_ip AS exposed_as FROM hb_vulnerability_finding v JOIN hb_devices d ON v.device_uid = d.device_uid AND v.provider = d.provider JOIN hb_exposed_assets e ON (d.ip_address = e.ip_address OR d.hostname = e.domain_or_ip) WHERE v.severity_id >= 4 AND v.status != 'suppressed' AND v.collected_at >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts that are both internet-exposed and carry critical vulnerabilities. Silence indicates no currently known overlap between exposed assets and unpatched findings.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_path, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\appdata\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\users\\public\\%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY process_path, process_name HAVING hosts < 3 ORDER BY hosts ASC
config.description: Detect infostealers by identifying rare processes executing from paths where users have write permissions, focusing on hosts identified in the scoping step.
config.expected_signal: Binaries running from user paths that are unique to one or two hosts across the estate.

primitive_config.label: Rare Binaries in User-Writable Paths
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_path, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\appdata\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\users\\public\\%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY process_path, process_name HAVING hosts < 3 ORDER BY hosts ASC
primitive_config.expected: Binaries running from user paths that are unique to one or two hosts across the estate.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%comsvcs.dll%minidump%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)
config.description: Detect the use of rundll32 and comsvcs.dll to dump LSASS memory, a built-in method for credential harvesting.
config.expected_signal: A specific command line execution. Zero rows indicates this specific technique was not observed on the monitored estate.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, actor_user_name, (unixepoch(time) / 1800) AS time_bucket_30m, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id IN (3, 5) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY device_hostname, actor_user_name, time_bucket_30m HAVING activity_count > {{min_file_actions}}
config.description: Identify potential ransomware encryption by finding bursts of file modifications and renames within short windows.
config.expected_signal: Spikes of file activity that exceed normal user background noise, suggesting automated encryption.

primitive_config.label: High-Volume File Activity in 30m Buckets
